# lago_billable_metric (Resource)

Manages a Lago billable metric.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "registry.opentofu.org/rpcpool/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

resource "lago_billable_metric" "api_requests" {
  name             = "API Requests"
  code             = "api_requests"
  aggregation_type = "count_agg"
  description      = "Total number of API requests"
  recurring        = true
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aggregation_type` (String) Aggregation type.
- `code` (String) Unique billable metric code.
- `name` (String) Billable metric name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Billable metric description.
- `expression` (String) Expression used by custom metrics.
- `field_name` (String) Field to aggregate for non-count aggregations.
- `filters` (Attributes Set) Optional metric filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `recurring` (Boolean) Whether the metric is recurring.
- `weighted_interval` (String) Interval used by weighted sum aggregation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Metric creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, set to the metric code.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago internal identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) Metric last update timestamp.

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `key` (String) Filter key.
